## Abstract
The GEO Series GSE309890 provides RNA-Seq data for *Escherichia coli* strain K-12 substr. MG1655 under various experimental conditions. The associated raw reads are available through the linked BioProject PRJNA1363958. This BioProject contains six sequencing runs totaling over 21 GB of data, which can be downloaded and processed for assembly. Assembly workflows should be compatible with the Illumina HiSeq 4000 platform used for RNA-Seq with paired-end reads under transcriptomic library preparation. 

## I. Introduction
**Background.** GSE309890 explores the impact of antidepressants on antibiotic resistance emergence in *E. coli.* The study involves transcriptomic sequencing under adaptive evolution and control conditions.
**Literature Review.** No PubMed association was identified for GSE309890, likely due to its unpublished or pending indexing status.
**Knowledge Gap.** While raw sequencing files are accessible, determining assembly compatibility and workflow requirements was unresolved.
**Objective & Hypothesis.** Assess whether raw reads from GSE309890 can be processed with a compatible assembly pipeline.

## II. Materials and Methods
**Study Design.** Link GEO metadata to BioProject and download associated sequencing runs.
**Materials.**
- Database: GEO (GSE Series), NCBI SRA (BioProject PRJNA1363958).
**Procedures.**
1. Query GSE309890 to confirm linked BioProject: PRJNA1363958.
2. Retrieve SRA runs for PRJNA1363958, identifying download paths and metadata:
   - Tool: `functions.geo_series`, `functions.ncbi_find_uids`, `functions.ncbi_sra_runs_for_project`.
   - Arguments: Accession inputs `GSE309890`/PRJNA1363958.
**Statistical Analysis.** Summarized SRA outputs (run count, sequencing strategy).

## III. Results
**Data Presentation.**
| Run ID        | Bases (bp)    | Avg. Read Length (bp) | Platform            | Layout | Download Link                                                                                                           |
|---------------|---------------|-----------------------|---------------------|--------|------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|
| SRR36018645   | 3,486,517,800 | 300                  | Illumina HiSeq 4000 | Paired | [Download](https://sra-downloadb.be-md.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/sos10/sra-pub-zq-1002/SRR036/36018/SRR36018645/SRR36018645.lite.1) |
| SRR36018644   | 3,124,630,200 | 300                  | Illumina HiSeq 4000 | Paired | [Download](https://sra-downloadb.be-md.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/sos10/sra-pub-zq-1002/SRR036/36018/SRR36018644/SRR36018644.lite.1) |
| SRR36018643   | 3,516,065,700 | 300                  | Illumina HiSeq 4000 | Paired | [Download](https://sra-downloadb.be-md.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/sos10/sra-pub-zq-1002/SRR036/36018/SRR36018643/SRR36018643.lite.1) |
| SRR36018642   | 3,597,738,300 | 300                  | Illumina HiSeq 4000 | Paired | [Download](https://sra-downloadb.be-md.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/sos10/sra-pub-zq-1002/SRR036/36018/SRR36018642/SRR36018642.lite.1) |
| SRR36018641   | 3,599,154,600 | 300                  | Illumina HiSeq 4000 | Paired | [Download](https://sra-downloadb.be-md.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/sos10/sra-pub-zq-1002/SRR036/36018/SRR36018641/SRR36018641.lite.1) |
| SRR36018640   | 3,408,998,700 | 300                  | Illumina HiSeq 4000 | Paired | [Download](https://sra-downloadb.be-md.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/sos10/sra-pub-zq-1002/SRR036/36018/SRR36018640/SRR36018640.lite.1) |

**Findings.** Six RNA-Seq runs from Illumina HiSeq 4000 are available for download.

## IV. Discussion
**Interpretation.** Data and platform compatibility confirm suitability for assembly workflows configured for Illumina HiSeq paired-end data.
**Context.** Provided links verify raw reads can be obtained without restrictions.
**Limitations.** Tools must integrate transcriptomic-specific workflows.
**Conclusion & Future Directions.** Assembly workflows may proceed for GSE309890, rechecking potential references provided for adaptive evolution data.

## References
[1] GEO GSE309890 Metadata: [GEO Record Page](https://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/geo/query/acc.cgi?acc=GSE309890)  
[2] SRA Runs: [Direct Links](https://ftp.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/geo/series/GSE309nnn/GSE309890/)
